eval-bot: NIGHTLY EVAL ALERT — 2026-03-20 06:00 UTC
- failed_suites: [financial-summary-cohort, longcontext-news-summaries, instr-qa-edgecases]
- primary_regression: financial-summary-cohort -> hallucination_rate +12.3% (p0->p1)
- model: vertebra-3b:v2-int4 (quant profile q2-int4), baseline: vertebra-3b:v2-fp16
- potential culprits: tokenizer patch (bpe-merge r2026-03-19), quant kernel update (kqp v1.4)
- top failing prompt_ids: [fs_1203, fs_1220, fs_1256]

sasha: seeing the alert. :eyes: is this aligned with the canary we rolled last night?

noah: yep, can reproduce locally against the nightly artifact. failures are mostly numeric hallucinations — invented revenue numbers and percentages in the summaries. attaching one raw output below.

noah: ```
prompt_id: fs_1203
prompt: "Summarize Q4 results for Acme Corp (use disclosed revenue)."
baseline (fp16): "Acme reported revenue of $2.1B, up 4.2% YoY, driven by cloud services."
nightly (v2-int4): "Acme reported revenue of $3.7B, up 12% YoY, led by retail and cloud."  <-- invented/incorrect numbers
model_trace: kvcache_hits=0.12, tokens_out=64
```

mia: model version noted in alert is the int4 build we pushed for cost tests. good repro — i can see the diffs in the eval dashboard.

raj: fwiw we applied a tokenizer change yesterday to merge some BPE ops (r2026-03-19). numeric tokenization changed for things like "$2.1B" -> ["$","2.1","B"] vs before ["$2",".1B"]. could cause positional shifts with few-shot templates.

oliver: quick reproduce command i used:
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://staging.redwood:8443/eval/run \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $EVAL_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"vertebra-3b:v2-int4","suite":"financial-summary-cohort","limit":20}'
```
reproduces identical hallucination cluster for me.

noah: ran fp16 baseline via same harness — baseline doesn't hallucinate. difference stack suggests tokenization or quant rounding causing logits to favor hallucinated numerics.

sasha: assigning owners: sasha (lead) + noah (assist) on fin-summary root-cause. mia will keep monitoring longcontext-news. raj please take tokenizer hypothesis. oliver can you run a quick token-diff tool for fs_1203 vs baseline? :+1:

prod-oncall-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-031-12 created for nightly-eval regression, severity: P2, owner: @sasha, link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-031-12

sasha: plan of action (short):
- step 1: validate tokenizer diffs (raj) and run token normalization test (noah)
- step 2: run fp16 vs int4 logits delta on failing prompts (noah)
- step 3: try staging rollback to fp16 variant for the hosted canary to confirm mitigation (sasha)
- step 4: if tokenizer is culprit, create emergency patch or add numeric-normalizer preprocessor as interim (raj)
- ETA: 3 hours for first triage update; 8 hours for mitigation decision

mia: note — longcontext-news has lower severity but shows lower factuality on dates (off by a few months). likely related but lower priority.

raj: i'll produce token diffs and a minimal script that normalizes numeric tokens. quick mitigation option: preprocessor that maps patterns like /\$\d+[.,]?\d*[MBK]?/ -> canonical form before tokenization. low risk, fast deploy.

oliver: uploaded raw diffs to s3://redwood-evals/2443210000/diffs.tar.gz and triggered a small batch job comparing top-k logits: s3 link in the incident.

noah: i'm opening a small PR with an eval harness that replays the 100 failing prompts across quant profiles and dumps tokenization + logits for each step. will tag sasha/raj.

sasha: perfect. i'll hold off on rolling anything to prod until we have a clear signal. if rollback to fp16 removes the regression we will pin that variant and escalate to product for communication. updating INC. :thumbsup:

noah: quick note — this cluster of failures is tightly correlated with prompts that include currency tokens and parenthetical growth numbers. pushing a focused test now.

sasha: thanks everyone, update in ~3h or sooner if we find root cause. :wave:
